title: [GMCP 203.018.03] Integration: Client connection runtime, caching, retries, and concurrency
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-018-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: The client runtime pools only security-equivalent connections, honors ttlMs and cacheScope, invalidates on notifications, applies deadline and cancellation budgets, retries only safe operations with jitter and circuit breaking, and enforces per-server plus global concurrency and memory bounds. Reconnect, half-open, duplicate-response, slowloris, crash-loop and thundering-herd tests prove deterministic recovery without duplicate side effects. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
